The object is a suspended cloth hammock/bed, not an open frame or rack (kind mismatch). Furthermore, as a frame it has no horizontal beams or base showing top surfaces, and the vertical posts extend off-screen without top faces.

The hammock is viewed from above in 3/4 perspective, showing the deep interior hollow and weave spanning rows 2 to 12 (11 pixel rows) with shaded back slope and illuminated floor, rather than a flat front silhouette.
